cardBody: Eight steps through assigning, reviewing, returning, guidelines, how trust changes, spot checks, corrections after approval, and the flow back into the knowledge base.
escHint: Press Esc to end it at any time.
todayBody: Work handed in by AI employees waits here for your review; items with failing checks come first.
reviewBody: The top half is what the employee says (the key points it marked, the guidelines it followed); the bottom half is the independent checks. You decide to approve or return.
returnBody: When you return work, pick one of three reasons: "It is wrong" sends this kind of work back to "Review every item"; the other two do not affect trust.
guidelinesBody: Feedback from a return can be saved as a guideline, and the employee then says which ones it followed when handing in work; guidelines need your confirmation and you can retire them at any time.
trustBody: Trust grows with reviews; reviewing key points needs your consent and you can take it back at any time.
spotBody: While you review key points, one in every 5 is picked for a full review; if it is wrong, this kind of work goes back to "Review every item".
correctionBody: If you find a mistake after approving, you can record it. It counts as "It is wrong", stays in the work ledger, and cannot be undone.
flowbackBody: Accepted knowledge base entries and confirmed guidelines go into the knowledge base; the source shows what checks they went through.
